node.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=1 mismatch has one normalized torsion chamber
node.statement: At N=2^40 and generic h=2^37+1, common subgroup scaling normalizes the repeated c=1 completion square A to one. Writing b=B/A,d=D/A,c=C/A,S=b+d,P=bd gives D_A=(Y-1)(Y-c)(Y^2-SY+P), while the canonical outer invariants scale as I_A=A^(-4h)I,J_A=A^(-6h)J. The normalized radical-free norm is A^(-(24h+12)) times the old norm. Moreover b,d,c lie in mu_N iff the forty-step recurrences T'=T^2-2P, P'=P^2, c'=c^2 end at (2,1,1). With the printed split, square, and distinctness conditions, this is an exact one-chamber (S,P,c) compiler, not an exclusion.
